errors.text_span: ein besonders markanter, senkrechter Sprung erfolgt im Herbst 2022 von etwa 123 auf exakt 141,2
errors.evidence: The purple line (Mindestlohn) jumps in autumn 2022 to a value of approximately 140, not exactly 141.2 as stated. The value 141.2 is the starting point for two other lines, but not the level reached by the purple line.

errors.text_span: Sie startet im Januar 2015 knapp unter 100
errors.evidence: The light green line (HVPI, Index 2015=100) starts at 100 in January 2015, not just below 100.
The light green line (HVPI, Index 2015=100) ends in autumn 2022 at a value of approximately 139, not 141.2.
